title: Financial transaction with an amount in minor units beyond long range, next to a 2^53+1 sequence
rationale: Pins the NP-015 fix in a realistic setting and asks the follow-up question that fix left open. The value survives exactly, but as text rather than a number, so the round trip is still not clean. The 2^53+1 ledger_sequence sits alongside as the control that must stay a number.
catchesBugClass: Integer overflow producing a wrong value rather than a reported loss - this goes red the moment anyone reintroduces longValue(). ledger_sequence separately catches any regression that routes integral values through double.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch the negative counterpart, nor a huge integer INSIDE an array element where quoting interacts with parseArrayValue type inference.

predicted.detail: Exact-but-retyped beats silently-wrong: the alternative it replaced truncated the low 64 bits and produced a plausible NEGATIVE number nothing downstream could detect. Still open and worth separate triage: the flattener could keep the BigInteger, or the reconstructor could re-widen.
